notes.title: A Difference like Day and Night
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44095533/61111b8a85a3fb9b11302f3e18939df22ddf7eaa.png"][/img][/p][p]Greetings Soldner,

we promised you more updates and we like to keep our promises. It's a question of Soldner Honour after all. 

Today we want to show you some progress. Some timelapsed progress to be precise. In Söldner it was always possible to play any map at any given time of day. Even with upscaled time so you would experience different times during a single match. 

This is exactly what we want to show today. Enjoy the beautiful landscape of Söldner from dusk till dawn. We picked some of the most scenic spots for you from lush forests to cosy spots down by the lake. Sit back, relax and enjoy the calm before the storm.

[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/xmbmpGZ11r0"][/dynamiclink]

Cheers 

schranzkopp[/p]

notes.title: It's been a while...
notes.content:
Greetings Soldner, 

yes, we're still alive. We just grabbed our Sniper kits and put on stealth Mode. Now just look at this picture we have for you and you must agree that with this much difference between old and new there's plenty of work to be done. But as you can see we're making progress, slow and steady, just as a patient Soldner waiting for the perfect moment to strike (you know, sniper kit and such 😉).

Enjoy the full beauty of this comparison over at http://soldnersecretwars.de/

With release coming closer and closer we will try to update you more frequently. Thank you for your patience this far.

Cheers

schranzkopp

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44095533/9c3b59c71ecf10c0b9a97d5045431253470ca88d.png[/img]

notes.title: Merry Christmas! We have a comparison shot for you
notes.content:
Greetings Soldner, 

once more it is the quiet time of the year and quiet it has become around the Remastered Version of our beloved Söldner Secret Wars. But fear not, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy that will be for all the players. For unto you is given new images of our progress. And this will be a sign for you: You will find an image of the current version of the game on one side and the same picture of the Remastered Version on the other. And a slider you shall have to reveal the full extent of what has changed.
Head over to [url=http://soldnersecretwars.de/]soldnersecretwars.de[/url] to see it yourselves!

The entire Söldner Development Team hopes you have fun with this (early) Christmas present and wishes you all Happy Holidays and a Happy New Year 2024. Stay tuned for more to come in 2024 ;-)

cheers,

schranzkopp

[b]LINK: [url=http://soldnersecretwars.de/]Comparison Shot (HD)[/url][/b]

notes.title: They're remastering Söldner: Secret Wars and I'm not sure anyone really knows why
notes.content: Hands up if you remember Söldner: Secret Wars. Okay, now hands up if you ever at any point in your life thought that what the world really needs right now is Söldner: Secret Wars Remastered. Obviously I can't see how many hands are up so I'm just going to assume the number is zero, but be that as it may, it's actually happening... Read more.

notes.title: Greetings Söldner!
notes.content:
Welcome to the community hub of Söldner: Secret Wars Remastered. This is the place to share your thoughts and to get the latest updates. We will keep you posted on the state of development regarding your favourite third-person combat game with fully destructible environment. It’s been a long journey and our team is more than happy to finally welcome you here on Steam! We are looking forward to you sharing your thoughts, suggestions and experiences, your character creations and all the things you will do or that may happen to you, while exploring the huge world map (22.750.000 km²!) and employing any of the over 100 firearms and 120+ vehicles.

We brought the toys, soon it’s up to you to take the tour and have some fun!
